style.toneOfVoice: Personalised Santa s Sleigh Christmas Night Light | Wooden Base LED Light Bring the magic of Christmas into your home with our Personalised Santa s Sleigh Christmas Night Light. Featuring a beautiful traditional scene of Santa flying over snow-covered rooftops in his sleigh, this stunning acrylic night light is personalised with your family name, creating a timeless festive decoration the whole family will treasure. Whether displayed on a mantelpiece, windowsill, shelf or bedside table, this elegant LED night light creates a warm, magical glow that s perfect for celebrating the festive season. PRODUCT DETAILS. Design: Traditional Santa s sleigh flying over a snowy village, personalised with your family name. Personalisation: Add your family surname or custom text to create a unique Christmas keepsake. Base Material: Premium birch wood with a finish. Lighting Options: Choice of Warm White LED or Colour-Changing LED. Power: USB powered with an easy-to-use inline switch (USB plug not included). Printing: Professionally UV printed for a crisp, vibrant and long-lasting finish. Dimensions. Wooden Base. Width: 15cm. Height: 3cm. Depth: 4.5cm. Acrylic Panel. Approx. 17.5cm (H) x 16cm (W). Perfect For. Christmas home décor. Living rooms and mantelpieces. Children s bedrooms and nurseries. Family Christmas decorations. Personalised Christmas gifts. Creating magical festive memories. Why You ll Love It. Personalised with your family name. Traditional Santa s sleigh design with timeless festive appeal. Soft ambient lighting creates a cosy Christmas atmosphere. Choice of warm white or colour-changing illumination. Makes a thoughtful keepsake gift for family and loved ones. Create a magical festive display with this Personalised Santa s Sleigh Christmas Night Light. Beautifully personalised with your family name and illuminated with a gentle glow, it s a timeless Christmas decoration that will become a cherished part of your family s festive traditions for many years to come.
